1445-2279-4871-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4871-8227.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5226-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1170-5060-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5060-5131-5330--202.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1170-5060-5131-5330--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

4399-4770-5998-7399.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5998-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

5477-7175-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5477-7175-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5477-7175-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1368-3755-4478-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-4478-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

147-4050-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4050-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4050-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

2397-6252-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2397-6252-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-851-3899-4552-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4373-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3713-5078-6006-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5412-6517.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-6517.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

141-554-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-5147.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield..
Repeat from step 3.

1965-2034-2350-5224.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {1} due to Stone Calendar, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

874-4195-4311-4574.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-4195-4311-4574.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2086-5256-6824.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

671-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-2034-5220--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
1456-2034-5220--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

1329-2178-2829-3661.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-2829-3661.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

719-1789-2921-5649.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
719-1789-2921-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

101-1987-4125-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1987-4125-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-4125-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

403-1912-3371-5299.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
403-1912-3371-5299.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Thassa's Ire by paying {1}{U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

307-3542-3925.notablePrerequisites:
Biting-Palm Ninja and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Biting-Palm Ninja or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
307-3542-3925.description:
Declare Palinchron and Biting-Palm Ninja as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Biting-Palm Ninja from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Biting-Palm Ninja's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Biting-Palm Ninja onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

164-1558-2963-4840.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating a Food artifact token.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and Food, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

77-2559-4069-4399.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Brilliant Halo.
Brilliant Halo and Starfield Mystic triggers.
Resolve the Starfield Mystic trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Brilliant Halo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Brilliant Halo by paying two life, targeting any creature.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

709-1627-1887-2232-4977.description:
Cast Tyvar by paying {2}{G}{G}, which enters with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Tyvar's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Tyvar dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Tyvar ability, causing you to get an emblem.
Cast Fyndhorn Elves by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Fyndhorn Elves spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Fyndhorn Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Llanowar Elves from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Fyndhorn Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Llanowar Elves by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Llanowar Elves spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Llanowar Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Fyndhorn Elves from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Llanowar Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 5.

618-3580-5147.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

651-3405-4046.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Pay {1} to activate Ayli, sacrificing Task Force and gaining life equal to its toughness.
